packageRules.description: Soak period before an update is eligible. Scoped by datasource on purpose: minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour defaults to timestamp-required, so a bare global value would withhold FOREVER anything whose datasource reports no release timestamp. docker is excluded for that reason (it reports a timestamp only for Docker Hub), which does mean container images get no soak and rely on review instead.

npm is where automated, worm-style compromises actually land, and an npm patch is rarely urgent. Does not cover transitive deps: lockfile regeneration re-resolves a bumped package's own ranges with no soak.
Auto-merge patch and minor updates once CI passes; hold majors for manual review.
Major bumps need a human (breaking changes likely).
